From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Redwood pen-test & vulnerability management details

Hi Samantha / Tom, nice to meet you via thread. I'm Redwood's Security Lead, I'll outline what we can provide and our standard vulnerability management practices. If you need anything in writing for procurement, we can export a short PDF of the items below.

Penetration testing:
- Redwood engages a SOC 2-qualified, independent 3rd-party pen-test vendor annually (most recent engagement completed Q1 2026).
- We can share a redacted executive summary from that engagement which excludes exploit PoCs, internal hostnames, and specific remediation steps that could aid attackers. The file name will be: redwood-pen-test-exec-summary-redacted.pdf.
- Full raw reports are restricted to a limited internal list and shared under NDA/controlled-access only. If Acme requires the raw report, we can discuss a mutual NDA and controlled review environment.

Vulnerability scanning cadence and detection:
- External (internet-facing) scans: weekly automated scans plus quarterly manual validation by a security engineer.
- Internal/CI pipeline scans: weekly static/DAST runs; automated SAST on PRs and daily dependency vulnerability checks.

Remediation & SLA (typical):
- Critical (RCE, active exploit, high confidence): acknowledge within 24 hours; mitigation or remediation plan within 7 calendar days (hotfix or workaround).
- High: acknowledge within 72 hours; remediation or compensating control within 30 calendar days.
- Medium: acknowledge within 10 business days; remediation within 90 calendar days depending on risk.
- Low: tracked and scheduled into regular maintenance windows.

Disclosure policy:
- We follow a coordinated disclosure process and request reasonable remediation windows (typically 90 days) before public disclosure. We will provide timely status updates to customers who report issues.

Artifacts & transfer:
- We prefer sharing SOC 2 and redacted pen-test summaries via a secure, expiring link (S3 presigned URL) or an enterprise file share. If Acme requires an NDA, we can route through legal.

If you can confirm the preferred transfer mechanism (secure link vs signed NDA + controlled share), we'll prepare the SOC 2 package and the redacted exec summary. Also happy to hop on a 30-min call with your security team if you'd like to review details.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
